veronese_identification.theorem: For conference Max+ with c_a=V₊ᵀy_a, φ_a=c_a c_aᵀ−2I: ⟨φ_a,φ_b⟩=(c_a·c_b)²−4d, and G:=(⟨φ_a,φ_b⟩) satisfies Gx=4d² Wx on 1^⊥. Hence nonzero spectra of P⊙P (even sector) and of the Veronese covariance Γ(B)=E[⟨φ,B⟩φ] on Sym_0 agree including multiplicities. In particular mult(λ₂(P⊙P))=mult(λ_max(Γ|Sym_0)). Proof: expand ⟨ccᵀ−2I,ddᵀ−2I⟩ using ‖c‖²=2d and E[ccᵀ]=2I; W_ab=(c_a·c_b)²/(4d²); PopP=(d²/N²)W; compare Rayleigh quotients on 1^⊥.

ky_fan_criterion.theorem: Let λ_max=max_{‖B‖_F=1,B∈Sym_0} Var(cᵀBc)=λ_max(Γ|Sym_0). By Fan's principle ∑_{i=1}^d λ_i(Γ)=max_{UᵀU=I_d} Tr(UᵀΓU). Thus mult(λ_max)≥d ⇔ ∃ orthonormal B_1..B_d in Sym_0 with Var(cᵀB_j c)=λ_max for all j. Equivalently the unit maximizers of B↦Var(cᵀBc) contain an ONB of a d-dimensional Γ-eigenspace for λ_max.
ky_fan_criterion.gap_link: Props 15.95–15.96: mult(λ₂)≥d and ‖κ‖²≤96n ⇒ gap ⇒ bi-tight empty (p≥5).

aut_schur.theorem: Any Aut(Max+) preserving pairwise dots acts on Sym_0 by g·B=gBgᵀ (via the induced orthogonal action on V₊) and commutes with Γ. By Schur's lemma Γ is scalar on every Aut-irreducible subspace of Sym_0. Hence every Aut-irrep appearing in the maximizer locus contributes its full dimension to mult(λ_max).
aut_schur.hint: For Paley, Aut contains (a cover of) PSL(2,p²), which has an irrep of degree (p²+1)/2=d. If that irrep embeds into the maximizer locus of Γ, then mult≥d. Embedding verified indirectly by mult=d certs at p=3,5,7.

attack_surface: To get mult≥d for all p≥5: exhibit d orthonormal maximizers of Var(cᵀBc) on Sym_0 (Ky Fan), e.g. Aut-irrep of degree d inside the maximizer locus of Γ (PSL(2,p²) discrete series). Still need ‖κ‖²≤96n (Prop 15.96) for gap. Or prove 16N/H directly.
verdict: Prop 15.97 proves mult(λ₂(P⊙P))=mult(λ_max(Γ|Sym_0)) via Veronese, Aut-Schur scalarity of Γ, and the Ky Fan criterion mult≥d ⇔ d orthonormal maximizers of Var(cᵀBc).
